A public statement qualifies as an insult if it mocks, degrades, or disparages the individual either personally or professionally. A team is considered to have "qualified" if it is included in the official list of teams participating in Worlds 2026 (including any Play-In stage) as confirmed by the tournament organizer. Qualification via any regional seed or slot counts.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the tournament organizer, Riot Games; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
